periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree diagonal orientation slanting upwards toward the lateral cranial region.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval; longitudinal axis is approximately twice the transverse width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Minor downward tapering observed at the medial-inferior margin near the rostrum.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness at the lateral shoulder regions, spanning the width of the forelimb attachment.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation, roughly 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Rounded, convex curvature at the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-yellow discoloration of the ventral and abdominal fur compared to the white cranial fur.
